title: ClawLoop: Self-Improving Agents via Harness-Native Training Loop
abstract_first: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has driven their deployment toward general-purpose harness environments, where LLM-based agents operate in sandbox workspaces and interact directly with file systems and shells.
